scope: Team metric budget gate fail-closed semantics
finding: A budget metric read error was treated as no exhaustion and the loop continued dispatching.
changes: Introduced explicit Continue, Exhausted, and Unavailable decisions.
Unavailable now requests team cancellation, audits team.budget_check_failed, stops dispatch, and marks pending rework failed.
Added a pure regression test covering all three decisions.

rust_test.required: at least 6 GB available and less than 80% used

limitations: Rust type-check, unit test execution, cancellation side effects, and server integration behavior remain unverified.
